description: Test suite for web search related functions in 'web-search.test.ts', exercising date normalization, filter support, and config merge functionalities.

methods.name: normalizeFreshness
methods.description: Normalizes different freshness labels based on the source, e.g., 'brave', 'perplexity'.

methods.name: normalizeToIsoDate
methods.description: Converts arbitrary date inputs to ISO date format if valid.

methods.name: isoToPerplexityDate
methods.description: Converts ISO date format to Perplexity's date format.

methods.name: buildUnsupportedSearchFilterResponse
methods.description: Creates a response object indicating unsupported search filters based on the provider.

methods.name: mergeScopedSearchConfig
methods.description: Merges plugin-specific configuration into the main search configuration, optionally mirroring API keys.
